priorityList: Pre-combat: Summon your pet (or use Grimoire of Sacrifice if talented) and pre-cast Haunt.
Maintain the Haunt debuff on your target at all times.
Maintain Agony on your target, refreshing it when it has less than 5 seconds remaining.
Maintain Corruption on your target, refreshing it when it has less than 5 seconds remaining.
Cast Dark Harvest if you have fewer than 3 Soul Shards and the cast will complete before your Agony or Corruption expires.
Summon Darkglare as soon as Dark Harvest is on cooldown.
Use offensive trinkets, combat potions, and racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) while Darkglare is active.
Cast Malefic Grasp if you have 2 stacks of Nightfall or if your Darkglare is about to expire.
Use Nightfall procs to cast Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt if not talented into Drain Soul).
Spend Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction if you have shards available or a Shard Instability proc.
Cast Malefic Grasp as a filler while your Darkglare is active.
Use Drain Soul (or Shadow Bolt) as your primary filler spell when no other priority is met.
